description: Defines utility functions for converting proxy server representations to and from string formats, including PAC strings, non-standard URIs, and Apple-specific dictionary representations. It also declares functions for parsing proxy schemes from URI schemes.

methods.name: PacResultElementToProxyServer
methods.description: Converts a PAC result element string to a ProxyServer object, handling various proxy schemes and invalid cases.

methods.name: ProxyServerToPacResultElement
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object to its string representation suitable for PAC results.

methods.name: ProxyUriToProxyServer
methods.description: Parses a non-standard URI string into a ProxyServer object, with a default scheme fallback.

methods.name: ProxyServerToProxyUri
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object into its string URI representation.

methods.name: GetSchemeFromUriScheme
methods.description: Extracts the proxy scheme from a URI scheme string.

methods.name: ProxyDictionaryToProxyServer
methods.description: Apple-specific utility to extract a ProxyServer from a CFDictionary, given scheme, host, and port keys.
